acceptance_boundary: Each receipt maps one immutable baseline URL to exact versioned public content and a successful function check: GitHub releases use clean-cloned source and repository tests; Hugging Face datasets use exact historical revisions, a non-empty data file and deterministic JSON/JSONL parsing. No Cloudflare Pages URL, current-main drifted repository, or aggregate historical claim is included.
